description: This file contains utility functions for handling 'BubbleNode' objects within a Lexical editor, including conversion from DOM elements, creation of new nodes, and type guards.

classes.name: BubbleNode
classes.description: A class representing a custom Lexical node used within the editor's plugin system.

methods.name: convertToBubbleElement
methods.description: Converts a DOM div element to a DOMConversionOutput containing a BubbleNode if applicable.

methods.name: $createBubbleNode
methods.description: Creates a new BubbleNode instance given a UUID.

methods.name: $isBubbleNode
methods.description: Type guard to check if a given node is an instance of BubbleNode.
